title: Master Class - Business Consultant - Life Sciences Commercial (United States)
description:
Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.

Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.

We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.

The Role
We are hiring high potential people who are early in their careers and want to pivot into Life Sciences Consulting through our Master Class Program.

Breaking into business consulting after starting your career down a different path can be hard. As an alternative to an MBA, this program is intentionally designed as the entry path to shape experienced professionals as Business Consultants capable of making an impact for the Life Sciences industry.
Early in the program, you will own key workstreams on customer-facing engagements to create high-impact business solutions while collaborating with team members at all levels of Veeva. You will be given the tools and resources to accelerate your consulting skills development.
Our Business Consulting team builds effective business and operational improvement strategies powered by Veeva’s unique industry insights, and market-leading technology. Our offerings are focused on speeding drug development, launching treatments more effectively, and shaping the best engagement for our customers.
If you’re graduating with an advanced degree, have 3-5 years of industry experience, or have served your country and are excited to pivot your career into consulting for a critical industry, Master Class is for you.
The anticipated start date is April 2027

What You'll Do

• Support and deliver all components of customer engagements (e.g., customer communications, workshops, stakeholder interviews, process and data analysis, managing timelines)

• Collaborate with Business Consultants to create deliverables that optimize customer operating and engagement models, processes, and business performance

• Leverage Veeva’s software and data to pull through tangible business and operational solutions

• 3-5 years of experience from one of the following paths: Life Sciences Industry experience; Advanced Degree (PhD, PharmD, MD); Other non-Consulting work experience; or Veteran/Military Service

• Desire to work within an intense, challenging program and environment

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• A problem-solving mindset: anticipating issues early, analyzing, and proactively finding solutions

• A process-driven person who loves digging into operations, numbers, and other data to find opportunities for improvement

• High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company

• High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a PBC and a “do the right thing” company, and we expect that from all employees

• Willingness to travel up to 20% of your time per year. Travel varies per customer engagement, coworking, internal meetings, and events with your team

title: Process Architect
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company - we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role
Join Veeva as we lead the life sciences industry’s fundamental shift from digital documents to process digitalization. As Process Architect, you will be the hands-on architect of this transition, converting legacy, document-centric processes into a modern, data-centric ecosystem within Veeva Validation Management. We are seeking a technical lead to convert legacy documents into normalized, relational data environments. This individual understands the requirements for mapping Commissioning, Qualification, and Validation processes, turning templates and static records into fluid, searchable, and actionable information.

In this role, you will act as a digitalization expert, guiding customers from paper-heavy or paper-on-glass solutions to data-centric workflows. You will also be responsible for owning the development and maintenance of specialized tooling and methodologies required to migrate and manage data across Vault environments.

This is a work anywhere, full-time permanent role with Veeva. Our work processes are designed so that you can be productive in the environment that works best for you. This is a customer-facing role and we have no work location requirement if you are in close proximity to an airport and able to meet future travel requirements.

What You'll Do

• Collaborate with customers to extract requirements from legacy Word documents and map them into structured Vault environments

• Reconcile customer-specific metadata to ensure data alignment and consistency across the entire validation lifecycle

• Execute bulk data loads and manage staged data for customer workshops and process exercises

• Partner with customers as a trusted advisor on best practices for importing and utilizing Validation Management for digitalized workflows

• Build and maintain libraries of digital records and examples to support customer implementations of application templates

• Develop and own the specialized tooling and methodologies required to migrate and manage relevant data across Vault environments

• Execute billable project work across various service tiers ranging from artifact mapping to enterprise-level deployments

• Partner with the strategy, services, and business consulting organizations to ensure an exceptional customer experience that reflects a deep understanding of validation processes across computer systems, equipment, cleaning, etc.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in life sciences validation with a deep technical understanding of CSV/A and CQV lifecycles for facilities, utilities, and manufacturing equipment

• Proven experience in a customer-facing consulting or billable professional services role with the ability to lead technical workshops and advise executive stakeholders

• Experience mapping complex customer business processes into standardized data languages to move organizations to paperless validation models

• Strong working knowledge of risk-based qualification approaches and industry standards such as ASTM E2500, ISPE Baseline Guides, and Annex 15

• Proficiency in bulk data loading tools and managing data integrity within cloud

title: Business Development
description: About Letly Letly is the AI-Native operating company built for the home. We believe the home should be autonomously run and we're building the software that will run all rental properties end-to-end. Our customers rarely arrive asking for a named product; they arrive with a problem - an agent they've had enough of, a property they can't get to, a tenancy they don't want to run. Our BD team works out which of our services solves it. Valuations, viewings, photography and key handovers sit with operations, so BDs focus on conversations, offers and closes. We've raised a $4m pre-seed and are a small, high-agency, engineering-oriented team, growing revenue at >100% month-over-month. We're hiring to facilitate this aggressive growth.   How we sell We sell outcomes not products. The BD team focuses on the customer, the problem, and the pain and routes it to the product that delivers the solution - priced properly. We’re honest about the trade, costs and what we’re responsible for - honesty is what drives customers back when competitors sell dreams. We’re clear and direct with our customers about our products. Our pricing is based on evidence, not gut feel, and we share this evidence with our customers openly. AI is a fundamental part of how we operate - from valuation and pricing, to research and prep, to coordination and booking. We understand and fully utilise AI, but a human always sells.   What we're looking for Experience. BDC: ~1-2 years as a higher performer in a fast-pace

Fueled by a unique culture built in and around meritocracy, we bring the passion, the know-how and the balance necessary to maintain the charted course we set for ourselves: to be the best, we employ the best. Are you ready to be part of the ICUC team?

The Role
ICUC is creating a new leadership role to own our automation and AI strategy across the business. This is a product and innovation mandate, not a workforce-efficiency one: the Director, Product Automation is responsible for how AI and automation get built into the actual work we do for clients - community management, strategy, insights, monitoring, and social listening, so our teams can work faster, with more precision, and with sharper focus on the client.

This is a founding, leadership-level position. You'll set the vision and build the function from the ground up, working closely across leadership to make sure ICUC's AI and automation strategy is as strong internally as it is in how we tell that story to the market.

Organizational Leadership

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

Syndio is the platform more than half the Fortune 100 trust to govern pay decisions, built on a decade of pay equity work and millions of pay records. Executive Engagement & Insights is the team that turns that into research, category leadership, and executive-level experiences elevating pay to a strategic decision rather than a compliance afterthought.

A CHRO or CFO decides to buy our platform once. Inspiring them to feel personally invested in what we’re enabling for their business takes something special, and that is what separates a vendor from a valued business partner. This role exists to help build that.

We're hiring a Director of Executive Engagement to own three things. The first is our Strategic Advisors program, along with an expansion launching later in 2026. You'll onboard advisors, keep them genuinely engaged, and nurture those relationships into outside credibility, introductions that open doors, and sharper strategic thinking. The second is the experience we create for executives among our customers. Working sessions, private briefings, peer roundtables, and executive forum programming that earns time from people who guard it closely and inspire leadership action related to pay governance. The third is our relationships with industry analysts, keeping them informed on Syndio and tapping into their expertise and insights.

You'll report to our SVP of Executive Engagement & Insights and work regularly with our CEO, and the senior leadership team. You'll also work closely with Marketing, Sales, and Product to connect them with customer executives, advisors, and analysts in ways that expand opportunities for the business and drive revenue.

Why this job is exciting

•
Build the advisor bench . Identify who we need, drive recruiting efforts, and design a sustainable rhythm that keeps senior executives willing to contribute year after year.

•
Design what executives remember. Create and continually refine working sessions, briefings, and executive forum programming that changes how a leader thinks about pay.

•
Turn access into revenue. Match the right executive to the right moment with Marketing and Sales, and get senior leaders invested before there's a deal on the table.

•
Influence at the highest levels. Build relationships with exceptional senior leaders and work directly with Syndio ’s senior leadership team.

•
Sharpen how we see the market. Industry analysts talk with buyers and vendors all day. You’ll bring what they see back to our leadership team and help influence our plans around it.

About you

• A track record working with senior executives at multi-national enterprises. You've earned time from people who guard it, and held onto it well beyond a single meeting.

• A record of relationships that produced business outcomes. Intros that became pipeline, advisors who influenced a decision, execs who became advocates. You can point to what came of them.

• Strong design instinct. You've built executive experiences and programming content from scratch. While you sweat the details of the room, you always measure the work by the specific value a leader walks away with.

• Influence without authority.

title: Staff Software Engineer

Elation is a cloud-based clinical platform for independent primary care practices. We want doctors spending their time on patients, not paperwork.
We're hiring full-stack engineers for our billing team.
Billing is a challenging domain. We receive data from insurers and partners who each follow the standards a little differently, but we need to make billing simple for our customers regardless of their payer arrangements and chase down every dollar we can for them across denials. We're using LLMs to take over a lot of work people currently do by hand. You'll design, build, and run these systems yourself.
If that sounds interesting, apply even if you don't check every box below.
What the work looks like

• Building systems that balance financial transactions between insurance, patients, and the practice. We’re building complex solutions that maximize reimbursement for practices and get them paid more while removing complexity for them.

• Working with inconsistent data from outside partners and handling the edge cases well

• Shipping AI features that real users depend on, and figuring out how to tell when they're wrong

• Improving a mature codebase while customers are using it every day

• Owning your work in production and working with Support when something breaks

• Collaborating with product and design to identify improvements and make them rapidly

Your first 60 days

• Ship something to production

• Scope and build a new feature with Product and Design

• Learn our stack and enough of the billing domain to be functional

• Join code reviews and production support

• Engage with customers and learn from their feedback

6-12 months in

• You own big features; collaborating with design and product stakeholders all the way through deployment, monitoring, and collecting insights on adoption

• You help set technical direction for your team on problems that you own

• Support teams, product owners, and sales representatives know you as someone who gets production issues resolved quickly and can speak to the solutions natively

Who we're looking for
You like owning a problem from start to finish. You think about how things will fail before they ship. You can identify when a problem needs a proper fix versus when a simple bandaid will do. You don't need to know healthcare billing already, but you're happy to learn it and to ask the experts a lot of questions. You can explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers. And you already use AI tools in your own work.
How we work
Each team has several engineers, an engineering manager, a product manager, and a designer. Engineers make the technical calls and work with Product on scope and priorities.
Requirements
Essential

• 5+ years of professional software development (8+ for Staff, including technical leadership)

• Production experience building and running backend services and APIs

• Comfortable working across the stack and in more than one language

• Experience with alerting/observability/instrumentation for real production solutions

• Clear communicator with technical and non-technical people

• Interest in building with LLMs

Nice to have

• Experience building production features with LLMs or machine learning

• A data-driven mentality

• Python and/or PHP, and MySQL

• TypeScript and React

• Payments, financial, or ledger systems

• Event-driven or distributed systems on AWS

• Observability and DevOps

• US healthcare, especially medical billing or claims

Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Basic understanding of patient care practices, safety procedures, and infection control standards. Ability to accurately document patient information and care activities. Current CPR certification or ability to obtain certification upon hire. Preferred Qualifications Previous home health or hospice experience. Experience caring for elderly, disabled, or chronically ill patients. Bilingual skills (English/Spanish) preferred. Familiarity with electronic medical records (EMR) systems. Additional certifications related to patient care or caregiving services. Strong knowledge of home healthcare regulations and best practices. Physical Requirements Ability to frequently stand, walk, bend, kneel, crouch, and reach throughout the workday. Ability to lift, transfer, push, or pull up to 50 pounds with or without assistance. Ability to assist patients with mobility and positioning activities safely. Ability to travel regularly to patient homes within assigned territories. Sufficient visual and auditory ability to monitor patient conditions and respond appropriately. Ability to perform repetitive physical tasks for extended periods. Capability to work in various home environments and under changing conditions.

Olyan, egész Európa-szintű pénzügyi platformot építünk a helyi vállalkozásoknak, ahol az egyszerű eszközök, az átgondolt dizájn és a valódi emberi segítség áll a középpontban. Értékesítési képviselőként kulcsszerepet vállalhatsz abban, hogy a magyar kis- és középvállalkozások digitális fejlődését támogasd. Nálunk nemcsak terméket értékesítesz - valódi, hosszú távú partnerségeket építesz, és aktívan formálod ügyfeleink jövőjét.

title: Customer success manager, enterprise

ABOUT WATERSHED

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

THE ROLE

Watershed is on a mission to turn sustainability data into a lever for business transformation. Our customers use our platform to uncover insights hidden in their operations, supply chains, and financial systems, then act on those insights to drive resilience and competitive advantage. What you’ll do:

- Proven success building relationships, especially with enterprise customers at an executive level.

- Have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. You have experience working on customer-facing work at the enterprise level.

- Curious and adaptable, eager to make sustainability data the next frontier of business intelligence.

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

title: Revenue Cycle Manager
description:
Job Description: Revenue Cycle Manager, Integrated Complex Care Associates
About the role
The Billing Manager is the first full-time hire for Integrated Complex Care Associates (ICC) and owns billing, provider enrollment, and billing compliance for the group. You will review and release every claim ICC sends to Medicare, enroll and support the physicians who join, and be the person physician offices and patients call with billing questions.
ICC is a California physician group serving patients with complex health needs, led by each patient's own primary physician. Physicians across California join ICC while keeping their own practices, and ICC bills Medicare for that work under its own group TIN.
What you'll do
Enroll and onboard physicians

• Own provider enrollment: each physician's 855I reassignment to ICC, ICC's 855B practice locations, PECOS and NPPES updates, revalidations, and Medicare EFT and remittance setup.

• Set up each physician's office to submit ICC patients' claims through ICC's payer ID, and confirm the first claims flow end to end.

• Keep ICC's provider roster current as physicians join or leave, including who each physician is paid through.

Support physicians and their offices

• Be the main billing contact for each physician's office: answer questions, run short onboarding sessions, and fix submission problems quickly.

• Walk physicians through their payment reports and how ICC's payments relate to their own practice's billing.

Review and release claims

• Review every claim before it goes to Medicare. Claims arrive from each physician's own practice system through ICC's payer ID, and ICC's system fills in ICC's TIN, the rendering physician's NPI, and the service location in the Stedi billing portal.

• Check each claim's CPT/HCPCS codes, modifiers, place of service, units, and diagnosis codes, then approve it, correct it, or send it back to the physician's office.

• Release approved claims to Medicare (Noridian, Jurisdiction E) under ICC's TIN, and track every claim to payment or denial.

Coding quality

• Sample claims regularly against the physician's EMR of record (ICC patients only) to confirm the documentation supports what was billed, and track error rates by physician.

• Use Nightingale's HCC view to spot conditions that may be undocumented. Where the record may support one, send the physician a compliant, non-leading query, and code only what the physician documents.

• Give physicians and their staff short, specific coding feedback, and escalate patterns to ICC's physician leadership.

Payments and denials

• Post and reconcile Medicare remittances (835s), work rejections and denials, and file corrections, reopenings, and appeals.

• Answer physicians' and office staff's questions about specific claims, remittance status, and payment reports.

• Reconcile what Medicare pays ICC with what ICC pays each physician or physician's practice.

Support patients

• Call each patient before their first ICC claim goes out to explain how ICC's name will appear on their Medicare statements and whom to call with questions.

• Answer patients' billing questions and resolve their concerns, working with the physician's office as needed.

Run billing compliance

• Screen every rendering physician and billing staff member monthly against the OIG exclusion list and SAM.

• Maintain ICC's billing and coding policies, document audits, and report findings to ICC's physician leadership.

• Identify, report, and return Medicare overpayments within the federal 60-day rule.

• Use access to physicians' EMRs only for ICC patients and only as much as each task needs, under HIPAA.

Reporting
You'll be employed by Integrated Complex Care MSO LLC, which provides management services to ICC and handles your employment, pay, and day-to-day administration. For coding, billing, and compliance decisions, you'll work under the direction of ICC's physician leadership (Kaushik Patel, MD) and follow ICC's approved billing and coding

title: Sr. Manager, Product Marketing Manager - Public Sector
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara , we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing - and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
Samsara 's Connected Operations platform helps organizations that depend on physical operations - fleets, construction, utilities, public works, and first responders - run safer, more efficiently, and more sustainably.
We're looking for a Sr. Manager, Product Marketing Manager, Public Sector to own the narrative, positioning, and enablement that will define how Samsara wins in government. You'll be the team's expert on how public sector buyers evaluate technology - from the contract vehicles they procure through, to the compliance bar they hold vendors to, to the mission outcomes they're ultimately accountable for.
This is a strategic, cross-functional role for someone who already understands government and frameworks like FedRAMP and StateRAMP/GovRAMP. The ideal candidate is someone who wants to build a public sector product marketing motion, not just execute inside one that already exists.
This is a remote position open to candidates based in the U.S. We prefer candidates based in or near Washington, D.C., or those able to work Eastern time zone hours.
You should apply if:

•
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your work will have real-world stakes - helping public agencies keep roads plowed, fleets safe, and essential services running for the communities they serve.

•
You're fluent in how the government buys technology: You understand procurement cycles, contract vehicles, and compliance frameworks well enough to turn them into a go-to-market advantage rather than a blocker.

•
You're energized by building, not just executing: Samsara 's federal go-to-market motion is still being defined - you'll have real ownership over the frameworks, positioning, and playbooks that shape it.

•
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara . We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development.

•
You want to be with the best: At Samsara , we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You'll be surrounded by a high-caliber team that pushes you to do your best work.

In this role, you will:

•
Lead as a player-coach: Manage a direct report while helping build the public sector PMM team's foundation - sharing in the strategic work, coaching for growth, and creating the frameworks that enable the function to scale.

•
Own public sector positioning and messaging: Develop and evolve Samsara 's core narrative for government buyers across federal, state, local, and education segments - grounded in mission outcomes rather than generic product benefits

•
Build Samsara 's federal go-to-market foundation: Partner cross-functionally to define how Samsara approaches the federal market, including messaging and enablement that reflect our compliance roadmap as it evolves

•
Translate compliance into a sales advantage: Understand the FedRAMP authorization process and impact

title: Customer Care Specialist
description:
V Rohlíku je Customer Care jedním z důvodů, proč jsme love brand. Zákazníci nás pravidelně chválí na sociálních sítích - protože jsme rychlí, lidští a protože nám na nich opravdu záleží.
Jako Customer Care Specialist budeš v první linii téhle zkušenosti. Budeš pomáhat zákazníkům přes telefon, e-mail a chat, řešit i složitější situace (včetně těch, které AI zatím nezvládne), a postaráš se o to, aby každý kontakt skončil s pocitem, že zákazník byl vyslyšen a dostal skutečnou pomoc.

PROČ JE TAHLE ROLE ZAJÍMAVÁ

- Budeš reprezentovat značku známou špičkovým zákaznickým servisem - a každý den pomáhat nastavovat laťku.

- Budeš pracovat se skutečnými lidmi a reálnými situacemi - žádné čtení skriptů, ale opravdové řešení problémů.

- Čeká tě inbound i outbound komunikace, nejen odpovídání na dotazy.

- Přidáš se do týmu, který drží spolu a zakládá si na tom, že věci dělá pořádně.

- Hybridní režim: po zapracování (obvykle 1-2 měsíce) je možný home office - 3 dny v kanceláři, 2 dny Home Office.

CO TĚ U NÁS ČEKÁ

- Komunikace se zákazníky přes e-mail, telefon a chat (inbound i outbound)

- Řešení požadavků, jako jsou změny času doručení, adresy, úpravy položek nebo kontaktních údajů

- Pomoc zákazníkům ve chvíli, kdy se něco pokazí - opožděné objednávky, problémy s doručením, reklamace

- Koordinace s kurýry, aby objednávky dorazily úspěšně a včas

- Úzká spolupráce s dalšími týmy (Logistika, Nákup apod.), aby se problémy řešily rychle

- Poskytování přesných informací o produktech a službách

- Sbírání zákaznické zpětné vazby a její sdílení, abychom naše služby dál zlepšovali

- Možnost kompenzovat reklamace kredity v rámci daných pravidel

- Přispívání k dobré atmosféře v týmu - Customer Care je týmový sport

CO OD TEBE POTŘEBUJEME

- Zkušenost ze zákaznického servisu nebo jiné zákaznicky orientované role je výhoda

- Výborná čeština je nutnost

- Angličtina je plusem

- Silné komunikační schopnosti a přirozeně prozákaznický přístup

- Odolnost vůči stresu a schopnost klidně zvládat konfliktní situace

- Schopnost rychle se učit a pracovat se základními nástroji (Google Workspace)

- Umíš přemýšlet kreativně a hledat pro zákazníka to nejlepší možné řešení, i když situace není úplně standardní.

- Ochota pracovat na směny je nutná, role může zahrnovat i práci o víkendech.

CO Z TOHO BUDEŠ MÍT

- Férovou odměnu - Dostaneš fixní mzdu a variabilní část. Dobrá práce si zaslouží jasné a férové uznání.

- Dobré jídlo každý den - Každý den si můžeš dát oběd zdarma a v kanceláři tě čeká čerstvé ovoce a zelenina. Protože dobré jídlo dělá dobrou práci.

- Život, nejen práce - Skutečná flexibilita - tři dny v kanceláři, 2 dny Home Office. A ano, máme i neomezenou placenou dovolenou založenou na důvěře.

- Osobní růst - Porosteš stejně rychle jako Rohlík. Každá výzva je příležitost naučit se něco nového a zanechat stopu.

- Reálný dopad - To, co děláš, má smysl. Uvidíš, jak tvoje práce mění způsob, jakým lidé jedí a žijí - od prvního dne.

- Uznání mezi kolegy - Tvoje úsilí nezůstane bez povšimnutí. Můžeš ocenit ostatní (a být oceněn) díky peer kreditům, které využiješ v naší interní „kavárně“.

- Xtra členství - Získáš členství Xtra zdarma a 10% cashback na všechny nákupy na Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz.

- Sport a wellbeing - Zůstaneš v pohybu díky firemním sportovním výzvám nebo dotované Multisport kartě.

- Tým, který drží při sobě - Budeš pracovat s lidmi, kteří jedou naplno, navzájem se podporují a společně slaví úspěchy.

- Zní to jako ty? - Jsi člověk, který bere věci do vlastních rukou, jedná rychle a dotahuje věci do konce? Tak pojď s námi „upéct“ něco skvělého.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

Build the case for renewal through demonstrated value, address retention risks early and equip Sales to lead renewal discussions. Identify expansion opportunities grounded in customer needs and business impact.

title: Senior Account Executive - EMEA
description:
Hello! 🦜

Thanks for checking out our job posting. You’ve already taken a tiny step towards being a part of our team - huzzah! We know that taking your next career step is as exciting as it can be exhausting. So, with that in mind, we’ve tried to keep our description simple and cliché-free to help you decide if PerchPeek and this role are a good match for you.

About PerchPeek

At PerchPeek we dream of a borderless world where people have the freedom to live and work where they please. Where ideas and resources flow where they’re most needed unrestricted by national borders. We strive to create a world of opportunity for anyone, anywhere - one move at a time .

We’re building a streamlined Mobility ecosystem to empower businesses and individuals to move anywhere in the world. We support employers and employees through every stage of the relocation process, providing an affordable, scalable, high-value service, powered by technology and relocation expertise.

Have you ever relocated? If so, you probably know how overwhelming it can be-immigration hoops, tax implications, housing, shipping, utilities, banking…the list goes on. No matter where in the world you go, relocating is complicated, time-intensive, and stressful. PerchPeek was conceived to change that.

For relocators employees, our goal is to guide them through every step of their move with a delightful mix of tech, coaching, content, and partnerships which work together to make relocating simpler, faster, and more fun.

For employers, we streamline the entire process of supporting international Mobility into one easy-to-use platform, turning Mobility into a strategic advantage for thriving globally.

Now you know why we’re so passionate about what we do!

About the role

The Senior Account Executive will win new business across the UK and Europe, focusing on fast-growing tech and AI scale-ups alongside larger enterprise mobility deals. You’ll build most of your own pipeline and own the full sales cycle, with a target of 1-2 new pilots per month once ramped, converting successful pilots into full rollouts. A successful candidate is a consistently high-performing, autonomous seller with a track record of generating pipeline and closing complex deals, who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to help shape the future of go-to-market at PerchPeek !

Role Responsibilities

Whilst every role in a startup has a degree of flexibility over time, here is what we see as the role’s main responsibilities:

•
Land new logos through pilots - Take fast-growing European scale-ups & enterprises from first conversation to a signed pilot, then convert that pilot into a full rollout.

•
Target clients - Fast-growing tech and AI scale-ups in the UK and Europe (roughly 500 to 5,000 employees). We already work with many of Europe’s fastest growing organisations and are targeting the rest. Once ramped, expect to land 1 to 2 new pilots per month.

•
Enterprise Mobility deals - About a quarter of the role is larger, mobility-led enterprise deals that come from industry events, often through RFPs and longer sales processes.

•
Build your own pipeline - You'll generate most of your pipeline through network, referrals, founders and VCs, trigger-based outbound and events.

•
Playbook input - We're still relatively early in our GTM journey and we'll be counting on you to shape how we win here and pave the way for future AEs.

•
Build the PerchPeek Network - Develop and grow relationships with others in the Mobility industry; be a PerchPeek evangelist and represent PerchPeek at events (online/offline, owned and externally organized).

About You

The type of person we think will be awesome in this role will likely have a track record of the below skills and experience:

• A track record of being a consistently top performing AE - ranked in top 1 or 2 of their team

• Experience running a pilot or proof-of-concept and converting it into a full contract

• Built their own pipeline: a large share

title: Manager, Business Development
description:
MANAGER, BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

 

About us
We’re solving AI’s hardest problem: alignment.

 

Encord is the data layer for Physical AI and enterprise, serving as core infrastructure for 300+ of the world’s leading AI teams, including Woven by Toyota, Hitachi, Skydio, AbbVie and Dyna, Walden and Agility Robotics. From autonomous vehicles and robotics to sports and healthcare, we’re solving AI’s hardest problem: turning complex, real-world data into production-ready intelligent systems.

 

We’re a team of founders, scientists, quants, researchers, and former Olympians, who’ve helped build some of the most successful companies in Silicon Valley, and alumni of MIT, Stanford, UC Berkeley, Oxford, Cambridge, and Imperial. We’ve raised $110M from legendary technology investors, early backers of companies like Databricks, ElevenLabs and Vercel, and we’re growing at an extraordinary pace.

 

We’re looking for exceptional people who want to help build a category-defining company, operating with high urgency and taking real ownership to help shape the future of AI.

 

The role
You’ll be the first-line leader of Encord’s Commercial Associates (CAs) and the person who makes sure they win. Our CAs aren’t traditional SDRs. They own their territory, build their own playbook, and learn by sitting on live deals alongside our senior sellers. You’ll coach them day to day, hold the standard for pipeline, and turn a group of ambitious, hungry people into our next generation of Account Executives.

 

You’ll be obsessively focused on making sure the leading AI teams, from exciting growth-stage startups to F500 organizations, know how Encord can help them bring their AI applications to market, and why they should choose to work with us. You’ll work with our Sales, Marketing and Customer Success leadership to keep the engine running, and you’ll have the autonomy to build the team to continue to achieve our targets.

 

What you’ll do

- Lead, coach and develop a team of CAs day to day through 1:1s, call reviews, pipeline reviews and live-deal shadowing

- Own the team’s pipeline and meeting targets, and inspect the numbers so you know where to step in

- Hire and onboard new CAs, with ramp plans that help them get productive fast

- Be the bridge between CAs and Account Executives, creating opportunities for CAs to sit on deals and learn

- Test new campaigns, messaging, sequences and channels, and share what works across the team

- Work with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on targeting, handoffs and key account pursuits

- Support each CA’s growth path with stretch work and a route into an AE seat

- Stay close to the market, joining prospecting and taking calls on key accounts when it helps

- Help shape how the CA program evolves as the team and the company scale

 

Who we’re looking for
You’re ambitious, driven, and make up for any gaps in experience with intelligence, grit, and a growth mindset. You’re a coach at heart. You get your energy from seeing the people on your team grow and win, and you’re comfortable being in the details of their day. You have natural hustle, build relationships easily, and thrive on lofty goals.

 

You like building things as you go and you move toward ambiguity. You want high impact and fast pace.

 

Experience requirements

- 4+ years in B2B SaaS or technology sales, including 2+ years managing or coaching a team of SDRs, BDRs or early-career sellers

- Track record of meeting or exceeding pipeline targets, both as an individual and as a leader

- Experience hiring, onboarding and developing reps, including helping them move into AE or other commercial roles

- Experience with outbound prospecting at volume, including into technical buyers such as engineers, ML practitioners or data scientists

- Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot), sales engagement tools and structured qualification methodologies

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

- Bonus: experience selling deve

title: Senior Lead Software Engineer - Performance and Resiliency Engineering
description:

Merchant Services is hiring an SVP/ED Performance & Resiliency Engineer to improve the performance and stability of critical, high-volume platforms. title: Staff GTM Systems Engineer

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

 

ABOUT YOU

The Staff GTM Systems Engineer at LiveKit is the technical owner and architect of the systems that power our go-to-market engine. You'll decide how our GTM stack is designed, what we build versus buy, and where we invest next - and you'll be hands-on building it: Salesforce architecture, integrations, enrichment pipelines, and the agentic workflows that help Sales and Marketing move faster and smarter.

Salesforce is our system of record for revenue, pipeline, and customer data. HubSpot is our marketing layer for campaigns and lead generation, and what it captures needs to flow cleanly and reliably into Salesforce. Around them sits a growing stack of enrichment, sales intelligence, billing, and data platform tools. You'll own the architecture that ties it all together: disciplined change management, observable pipelines, data models built for AI consumption, and agentic workflows that act on GTM signals at scale - designed to serve the business for years, not quarters.

This role sits at the intersection of GTM, Data, Finance, and Engineering. You'll work directly with senior leaders to shape the GTM systems roadmap, turn business strategy into technical plans, and guide decisions that span multiple teams. You'll also help grow the engineers around you, setting the technical standards and practices the team builds on.

You understand the difference between owning a system and gatekeeping one. Sales lives in Salesforce. Marketing lives in HubSpot. Your job is to make sure both are governed well enough that others can work in them effectively, and powerful enough that the GTM team can do things they couldn't do before.

You'll thrive as a Staff GTM Systems Engineer if you:

- Are known as the go-to person for tough technical problems, and have good judgment about which ones matter most.

- Think in systems and long time horizons, and can make confident architectural decisions with incomplete information.

- Can clearly explain complex technical concepts and tradeoffs to engineers and executives alike.

- Believe systems should be managed with engineering discipline.

- Ship fast and reliably - your work holds up in production.

- Are a fast learner, frequently picking up new languages and tools.

- Find real satisfaction in mentoring other engineers and helping them grow.

- Lead build-vs-buy and procurement decisions: evaluate vendors, run proofs of concept, assess security and integration fit, and partner with Director of GTM Systems and Analytics, Finance, Legal, and IT on selection and renewals.

- Shape the GTM systems roadmap with senior leaders across Sales, Marketing, RevOps, Finance, and Engineering: align on requirements, sequence investments, make clear tradeoffs, and lead cross-functional initiatives to completion.

- Own HubSpot for campaigns and lead generation, along with the HubSpot-Salesforce sync - so leads, contacts, and engagement signals reach the revenue pipeline without drift or silent failures.
